SELECT b.tenant_id::text AS tenantId, a.agent_id::text AS agentId, a.name AS name, a.description AS description, (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_version v WHERE v.agent_id = a.agent_id) AS versionCount, av.version_number AS latestVersionNumber, av.published_at AS latestPublishedAt, d.version AS defVersion, d.lifecycle_state::text AS defLifecycleState, d.roles::text AS defRoles, d.enabled_skills::text AS defEnabledSkills, d.capability_tags::text AS defCapabilityTags, d.overrides::text AS defOverrides, d.model_ref AS defModelRef, d.skill_bundles::text AS defSkillBundles, d.instructions::text AS defInstructions, d.orchestration::text AS defOrchestration, om.mode AS orchestrationMode, COALESCE(tc.tenant_count, 0) AS tenantCount, pc.pending_state AS pendingState, pc.pending_at AS pendingAt FROM tenant_agent_binding b JOIN agent a ON a.agent_id = b.agent_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT v.version_number, v.published_at FROM agent_version v WHERE v.agent_id = a.agent_id ORDER BY v.version_number DESC LIMIT 1 ) av ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d.version, d.lifecycle_state, d.roles, d.enabled_skills, d.capability_tags, d.overrides, d.model_ref, d.skill_bundles, d.instructions, d.orchestration FROM cap_agent_def d WHERE d.agent_id = a.agent_id ORDER BY d.version DESC LIMIT 1 ) d ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN d2.orchestration IS NULL OR d2.orchestration IN ('{}'::jsonb, 'null'::jsonb, '""'::jsonb) OR jsonb_typeof(d2.orchestration) <> 'object' THEN NULL WHEN d2.orchestration ->> 'mode' IS NOT NULL THEN d2.orchestration ->> 'mode' ELSE NULL END AS mode FROM cap_agent_def d2 WHERE d2.agent_id = a.agent_id ORDER BY d2.version DESC LIMIT 1 ) om ON TRUE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT agent_id, count(*) AS tenant_count FROM tenant_agent_binding WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY agent_id ) tc ON tc.agent_id = a.agent_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT pr.state AS pending_state, pr.requested_at AS pending_at FROM cap_config_publish_request pr WHERE pr.state IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(pr.payload::jsonb -> 'agents') = 'array' THEN pr.payload::jsonb -> 'agents' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) ag WHERE ag ->> 'agentId' = a.agent_id::text ) OR pr.payload::jsonb -> 'lifecycle' ->> 'objectId' = a.agent_id::text OR (pr.resource_kind = 'AGENT' AND pr.resource_id = a.agent_id::text) ) ORDER BY pr.requested_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) pc ON TRUE WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (#{tenantIdFilter}::uuid IS NULL OR b.tenant_id = #{tenantIdFilter}::uuid) ORDER BY b.tenant_id, a.name, a.agent_id

SELECT pr.request_id::text AS changeId, 'CONFIG' AS category, pr.tenant_id::text AS tenantId, pr.operation AS action, pr.state AS state, pr.target_version AS targetVersion, pr.reason AS reason, pr.requester_id AS actorId, pr.requested_at AS requestedAt, pr.applied_at AS appliedAt, -- after_config：本次申请里该 Agent 的完整配置（变更后） ( SELECT ag FROM jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(pr.payload::jsonb -> 'agents') = 'array' THEN pr.payload::jsonb -> 'agents' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) ag WHERE ag ->> 'agentId' = #{agentId} LIMIT 1 )::text AS afterConfig, -- before_config：变更前配置快照 -- ⚠️ **首选 before_payload 列**（提交申请时由服务端写入的当刻快照）。 -- 事后反查 cap_agent_def 不可靠：目标版本可能已被清理， -- 或已被后续变更覆盖，算出来的并不是当次的真实基线。 -- ⚠️ before_payload 为 NULL（升级前的历史行）时才回退到「按版本号反查」， -- 只为让老数据仍有可读基线；新数据一律走快照。 COALESCE( ( SELECT ag::text FROM jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(pr.before_payload -> 'agents') = 'array' THEN pr.before_payload -> 'agents' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) ag WHERE ag ->> 'agentId' = #{agentId} LIMIT 1 ), CASE WHEN pr.target_version IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ( SELECT to_jsonb(d) FROM cap_agent_def d WHERE d.agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid AND d.version < pr.target_version ORDER BY d.version DESC LIMIT 1 )::text END ) AS beforeConfig FROM cap_config_publish_request pr WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(pr.payload::jsonb -> 'agents') = 'array' THEN pr.payload::jsonb -> 'agents' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) ag WHERE ag ->> 'agentId' = #{agentId} ) OR pr.payload::jsonb -> 'lifecycle' ->> 'objectId' = #{agentId} OR (pr.resource_kind = 'AGENT' AND pr.resource_id = #{agentId}) ORDER BY pr.requested_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
